svg.aria-label: Dispatch, the machine behind its exits
svg.text: Dispatch, the machine behind its exits
Drawn from the Passages room. A micro-op comes in and takes one exit, either a wait or a step on to the next room. Each exit is a state, and each pair of states has one arc.
the queue took one this cycle
the MUL buffer is full and a MUL op
while an older one is waiting
while the MUL buffer is full
until an entry frees in the dispatch buffers
Solid arcs rest on measurements or two sources.
Dashed arcs rest on one source or are derived or inferred.
~ wait older, wait behind an older micro-op
○ wait width, dispatch width used up
~ wait inflow, the queue took one already
○ wait buffer full, the buffer is full
○ wait queue full, into the buffer, but the queues are full
~ enter buffer, into a dispatch buffer
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
